category: Computer Vision & Point Cloud Toolboxes II > Point Cloud Processing, Deep Learning Detection & Segmentation, OCR Training & Fiducials
description: Point cloud I/O, filtering, model fitting, segmentation, registration, feature matching and SLAM helpers (Point Cloud Toolbox, formerly Lidar Toolbox, and Computer Vision Toolbox), plus deep learning object detection/segmentation training data, evaluation, OCR training and fiducial/marker detection. Complements the basic computer vision entries (pointCloud, pcshow, pcregistericp, ocr, semanticseg, YOLO v4).

tools.name: pcread
tools.description: Reads a 3-D point cloud from a PLY or PCD file into a pointCloud object, including colors, normals and intensity when present.
tools.usage: ptCloud = pcread(filename)
tools.notes: For LAS/LAZ use lasFileReader, for Velodyne PCAP velodyneFileReader, for E57 e57FileReader. pcwrite writes PLY/PCD.

tools.name: pcwrite
tools.description: Writes a pointCloud object to a PLY or PCD file in ASCII, binary or (PCD) compressed encoding.
tools.usage:
pcwrite(ptCloud, filename)
pcwrite(ptCloud, filename, Encoding=encodingType)
tools.example:
pc = pointCloud(rand(1000,3));
pcwrite(pc, "random.pcd", Encoding="binary");
tools.notes: Organized point clouds are preserved in PCD format.

tools.name: pcdownsample
tools.description: Downsamples a point cloud by random sampling, grid (voxel) averaging, grid nearest, or nonuniform box sampling, reducing size while preserving structure before registration or meshing.
tools.usage:
ptCloudOut = pcdownsample(ptCloudIn, "random", percentage)
ptCloudOut = pcdownsample(ptCloudIn, "gridAverage", gridStep)
ptCloudOut = pcdownsample(ptCloudIn, "gridNearest", gridStep)
ptCloudOut = pcdownsample(ptCloudIn, "nonuniformGridSample", maxNumPoints)

parameters.name: percentage
parameters.description: Fraction of points to keep for random sampling.

parameters.name: maxNumPoints
parameters.description: Maximum points per box (>= 6) for nonuniform sampling.

tools.notes: nonuniformGridSample preserves normals quality for ICP plane-to-plane metrics.

tools.name: pcdenoise
tools.description: Removes outlier noise from a point cloud using a statistical filter on the mean distance of each point to its nearest neighbors.
tools.usage:
ptCloudOut = pcdenoise(ptCloudIn)
[ptCloudOut, inlierIndices, outlierIndices] = pcdenoise(ptCloudIn, Name=Value)

parameters.name: NumNeighbors
parameters.description: Neighbors used for the mean distance (default 4).

tools.notes: pcmedian applies median filtering to coordinates of organized clouds.

tools.name: pcnormals
tools.description: Estimates surface normals of a point cloud by fitting local planes to each point's nearest neighbors. Normals are needed for plane-to-plane ICP, meshing and shading.
tools.usage:
normals = pcnormals(ptCloud)
normals = pcnormals(ptCloud, k)
tools.notes: Normal orientation is ambiguous; flip normals toward a viewpoint if needed.

tools.name: pcmerge
tools.description: Merges two point clouds into one using a box grid filter of given step so overlapping regions are averaged rather than duplicated; typical when stitching registered scans.
tools.usage: ptCloudOut = pcmerge(ptCloudA, ptCloudB, gridStep)

parameters.name: gridStep
parameters.description: Voxel size used to merge points.

tools.example:
tform = pcregistericp(pcMoving, pcFixed);
merged = pcmerge(pcFixed, pctransform(pcMoving, tform), 0.01);
tools.notes: pccat concatenates without filtering; pcalign aligns and merges arrays of clouds with known poses.

tools.name: pctransform
tools.description: Applies a rigid, similarity or affine 3-D transformation (or a per-point displacement field) to a point cloud, returning the transformed cloud with normals updated.
tools.usage:
ptCloudOut = pctransform(ptCloudIn, tform)
ptCloudOut = pctransform(ptCloudIn, D)
tools.example:
tform = rigidtform3d([0 0 45], [1 0 0]);    % rotation (deg) and translation
pcOut = pctransform(pcread("teapot.ply"), tform);
tools.notes: Registration functions return rigidtform3d objects that can be passed directly.

tools.name: pcfitplane
tools.description: Fits a plane to a point cloud with MSAC (robust RANSAC variant), optionally constrained to a reference orientation, returning a planeModel plus inlier and outlier indices. Commonly used for ground or table removal.
tools.usage:
model = pcfitplane(ptCloud, maxDistance)
model = pcfitplane(ptCloud, maxDistance, referenceVector, maxAngularDistance)
[model, inlierIndices, outlierIndices, meanError] = pcfitplane(___, Name=Value)
tools.notes: Results are random; set rng for reproducibility. pcfitcylinder, pcfitsphere and pcfitcuboid fit other primitives.

tools.name: pcfitcylinder
tools.description: Fits a cylinder to a point cloud with MSAC, optionally with a reference axis orientation and sample indices, returning a cylinderModel (center, radius, height, orientation) and inliers.
tools.usage:
model = pcfitcylinder(ptCloud, maxDistance)
model = pcfitcylinder(ptCloud, maxDistance, referenceVector, maxAngularDistance)
[model, inlierIndices, outlierIndices, meanError] = pcfitcylinder(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: Inlier distance to the cylinder surface.

tools.notes: Requires normals (computed automatically if absent in newer releases).

tools.name: pcfitsphere
tools.description: Fits a sphere to a point cloud with MSAC and returns a sphereModel with center and radius, along with inlier/outlier indices.
tools.usage:
model = pcfitsphere(ptCloud, maxDistance)
[model, inlierIndices, outlierIndices, meanError] = pcfitsphere(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: maxDistance
parameters.description: Maximum distance from the sphere for inliers.

tools.notes: Use SampleIndices from a region of interest (findNeighborsInRadius) for cluttered scenes.

tools.name: pcsegdist
tools.description: Segments a point cloud into clusters using Euclidean distance: points closer than a minimum distance belong to the same cluster. A standard step to separate objects after ground removal.
tools.usage:
labels = pcsegdist(ptCloud, minDistance)
[labels, numClusters] = pcsegdist(ptCloud, minDistance, Name=Value)
tools.example:
[labels, n] = pcsegdist(objects, 0.5, NumClusterPoints=[20 Inf]);
pcshow(objects.Location, labels); colormap(lines(n))
tools.notes: pcclusterprops (newer releases) computes cluster properties; segmentLidarData segments organized lidar scans.

tools.name: segmentGroundFromLidarData
tools.description: Segments ground points in an organized lidar point cloud using elevation angle differences between neighboring rows, returning a logical ground mask.
tools.usage:
groundPtsIdx = segmentGroundFromLidarData(ptCloud)
groundPtsIdx = segmentGroundFromLidarData(ptCloud, Name=Value)

parameters.name: ptCloud
parameters.description: Organized point cloud (M-by-N-by-3), e.g. from velodyneFileReader.

tools.notes: For unorganized clouds use pcorganize first, segmentGroundSMRF (aerial data) or pcfitplane.

tools.name: pcregisterndt
tools.description: Registers a moving point cloud to a fixed one using the Normal Distributions Transform, which models the fixed cloud as voxelized Gaussians; robust and fast for lidar scan matching.
tools.usage:
tform = pcregisterndt(moving, fixed, gridStep)
[tform, movingReg, rmse] = pcregisterndt(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: gridStep
parameters.description: Voxel size of the NDT grid.

tools.notes: Other registration methods: pcregistericp (ICP), pcregistercpd (CPD, nonrigid), pcregisterloam, pcregisterfgr, pcregistercorr.

tools.name: pcregistercpd
tools.description: Registers two point clouds using the Coherent Point Drift algorithm with rigid, affine or nonrigid transformation models; handles noise, outliers and deformations better than ICP at higher cost.
tools.usage:
tform = pcregistercpd(moving, fixed)
[tform, movingReg, rmse] = pcregistercpd(moving, fixed, Name=Value)
tools.notes: Downsample to a few thousand points; nonrigid CPD scales poorly with point count.

tools.name: extractFPFHFeatures
tools.description: Extracts Fast Point Feature Histogram (FPFH) descriptors describing local geometry around points, used for global (feature-based) registration and place recognition.
tools.usage:
features = extractFPFHFeatures(ptCloud)
[features, validIndices] = extractFPFHFeatures(ptCloud, indices, Name=Value)

parameters.name: indices
parameters.description: Point indices at which to compute descriptors (all by default).

tools.notes: Estimate a coarse transform from matches with estgeotform3d, then refine with ICP.

tools.name: pcmatchfeatures
tools.description: Finds matching feature pairs between two point clouds from their descriptors (e.g. FPFH), with optional spatial consistency rejection.
tools.usage:
indexPairs = pcmatchfeatures(features1, features2)
[indexPairs, scores] = pcmatchfeatures(features1, features2, ptCloud1, ptCloud2, Name=Value)
tools.notes: estgeotform3d uses M-estimator SAC to reject remaining outliers.

tools.name: pcplayer
tools.description: Creates a player for visualizing streaming 3-D point cloud data (e.g. lidar frames) with fixed axis limits, updated efficiently in a loop.
tools.usage:
player = pcplayer(xlimits, ylimits, zlimits)
player = pcplayer(___, Name=Value)
view(player, ptCloud)
tools.notes: pcviewer (newer) offers interactive inspection of large point clouds.

tools.name: pcshowpair
tools.description: Visualizes the difference between two point clouds by overlaying them in false colors (magenta/green) or blended, typically to check registration quality.
tools.usage:
pcshowpair(ptCloudA, ptCloudB)
pcshowpair(___, Name=Value)
ax = pcshowpair(___)
tools.example:
pcshowpair(movingReg, fixed, VerticalAxis="Z")
title("Registration result")
tools.notes: Use pcshowMatchedFeatures to visualize feature correspondences.

tools.name: velodyneFileReader
tools.description: Reads Velodyne lidar packet captures (PCAP) and returns organized point cloud frames with timestamps for supported device models.
tools.usage:
veloReader = velodyneFileReader(fileName, deviceModel)
veloReader = velodyneFileReader(___, Name=Value)
ptCloud = readFrame(veloReader, frameNumber)
tools.notes: Similar readers: ousterFileReader, hesaiFileReader, ibeoLidarReader; velodynelidar streams live sensors (support package).

tools.name: lasFileReader
tools.description: Reads LAS/LAZ aerial lidar files, returning point clouds with optional point attributes (classification, intensity, GPS time, return number) and support for region and class filtering.
tools.usage:
lasReader = lasFileReader(fileName)
ptCloud = readPointCloud(lasReader)
[ptCloud, pointAttributes] = readPointCloud(lasReader, Name=Value)

parameters.name: ROI
parameters.description: [xmin xmax ymin ymax zmin zmax] region to read.

tools.notes: lasFileWriter writes LAS/LAZ. pc2dem converts point clouds to digital elevation models.

tools.name: pcviewset
tools.description: Manages views (point clouds with absolute poses) and connections (relative poses with information matrices) for lidar odometry and SLAM, and builds and optimizes pose graphs.
tools.usage:
vSet = pcviewset
vSet = addView(vSet, viewId, absPose, PointCloud=ptCloud)
vSet = addConnection(vSet, viewId1, viewId2, relPose, infoMat)
G = createPoseGraph(vSet)
vSet = optimizePoses(vSet)
tools.notes: Use pcalign to build a map from view poses; scanContextLoopDetector detects loop closures.

tools.name: pointPillarsObjectDetector
tools.description: Creates or wraps a PointPillars deep learning detector that finds 3-D oriented bounding boxes (cuboids) of objects such as cars and pedestrians in lidar point clouds.
tools.usage:
detector = pointPillarsObjectDetector(pcRange, classNames, anchorBoxes)
detector = trainPointPillarsObjectDetector(trainingData, detector, options)
[bboxes, scores, labels] = detect(detector, ptCloud)

parameters.name: pcRange
parameters.description: [xmin xmax ymin ymax zmin zmax] processed region.

parameters.name: classNames / anchorBoxes
parameters.description: Object classes and per-class anchor boxes.

tools.notes: Training data typically comes from the Lidar Labeler app (combine a fileDatastore of clouds with a boxLabelDatastore of cuboids).

tools.name: boxLabelDatastore
tools.description: Creates a datastore of bounding box labels (axis-aligned, rotated or cuboid) and class labels, which is combined with an image or point cloud datastore to train object detectors.
tools.usage:
blds = boxLabelDatastore(tbl1, ..., tblN)
blds = boxLabelDatastore(___, bSet)

parameters.name: tbl
parameters.description: Table with one column per class of M-by-4 (or M-by-5/M-by-9) boxes, or boxes plus a categorical label column.

tools.notes: countEachLabel summarizes label counts; balanceBoxLabels helps with class imbalance in large images.

tools.name: objectDetectorTrainingData
tools.description: Creates training datastores (images and box labels) from groundTruth objects exported by the Image Labeler or Video Labeler apps, optionally subsampling video frames.
tools.usage:
[imds, blds] = objectDetectorTrainingData(gTruth)
[imds, blds] = objectDetectorTrainingData(gTruth, Name=Value)
trainingDataTable = objectDetectorTrainingData(gTruth)

parameters.name: SamplingFactor / WriteLocation / NamePrefix
parameters.description: Frame subsampling and image extraction options for video sources.

tools.example:
[imds, blds] = objectDetectorTrainingData(gTruth, SamplingFactor=5, WriteLocation="frames");
ds = combine(imds, blds);
tools.notes: pixelLabelTrainingData is the semantic segmentation counterpart.

tools.name: estimateAnchorBoxes
tools.description: Estimates anchor box sizes for anchor-based detectors (YOLO, SSD, Faster R-CNN) by clustering the widths and heights of labeled boxes with an IoU distance.
tools.usage:
anchorBoxes = estimateAnchorBoxes(trainingData, numAnchors)
[anchorBoxes, meanIoU] = estimateAnchorBoxes(___)

parameters.name: trainingData
parameters.description: boxLabelDatastore or combined datastore with boxes.

tools.example:
[anchors, iou] = estimateAnchorBoxes(blds, 6);
anchors = sortrows(anchors, 1, "descend");
tools.notes: Higher meanIoU means anchors fit the data better; try several numAnchors values.

tools.name: evaluateObjectDetection
tools.description: Evaluates object detection results against ground truth, returning an objectDetectionMetrics object with average precision, mAP, precision/recall curves and per-class and per-image statistics at chosen overlap thresholds.
tools.usage:
metrics = evaluateObjectDetection(detectionResults, groundTruthData)
metrics = evaluateObjectDetection(___, threshold, Name=Value)

parameters.name: detectionResults
parameters.description: Table or datastore of boxes, scores and labels from detect.

parameters.name: groundTruthData
parameters.description: boxLabelDatastore or table of ground truth.

tools.notes: Introduced R2023b, superseding evaluateDetectionPrecision. The Object Detector Analyzer app visualizes these metrics.

tools.name: selectStrongestBboxMulticlass
tools.description: Performs class-wise non-maximum suppression on multiclass detections, keeping the highest scoring boxes and removing overlapping duplicates.
tools.usage: [selectedBboxes, selectedScores, selectedLabels, index] = selectStrongestBboxMulticlass(bboxes, scores, labels, Name=Value)
tools.example: [b, s, l] = selectStrongestBboxMulticlass(bboxes, scores, labels, OverlapThreshold=0.4);
tools.notes: selectStrongestBbox is the single-class version; bboxOverlapRatio computes IoU matrices.

tools.name: bboxOverlapRatio
tools.description: Computes the overlap ratio (intersection over union, or over the minimum area) between two sets of axis-aligned or rotated bounding boxes.
tools.usage:
overlapRatio = bboxOverlapRatio(bboxA, bboxB)
overlapRatio = bboxOverlapRatio(bboxA, bboxB, ratioType)

parameters.name: bboxA / bboxB
parameters.description: M-by-4 [x y w h] (or rotated M-by-5) boxes.

tools.notes: Returns an M-by-N matrix for all pairs.

tools.name: pixelLabelDatastore
tools.description: Creates a datastore of pixel label images (categorical masks) for semantic segmentation training and evaluation, from files or groundTruth objects.
tools.usage:
pxds = pixelLabelDatastore(gTruth)
pxds = pixelLabelDatastore(location, classNames, pixelLabelIDs)
pxds = pixelLabelDatastore(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: classNames / pixelLabelIDs
parameters.description: Class names and the pixel values (or RGB triplets) that encode them.

tools.notes: Combine with an imageDatastore for training (combine(imds, pxds)).

tools.name: unet
tools.description: Creates a U-Net convolutional network (dlnetwork) for semantic image segmentation with configurable encoder depth and filters. unet3d creates the volumetric variant.
tools.usage:
net = unet(imageSize, numClasses)
net = unet(imageSize, numClasses, Name=Value)
tools.notes: Introduced R2024a (replaces unetLayers). deeplabv3plus provides a pretrained-backbone alternative.

tools.name: deeplabv3plus
tools.description: Creates a DeepLab v3+ semantic segmentation network on top of a pretrained backbone (ResNet-18/50, MobileNet-v2, Xception, Inception-ResNet-v2), typically giving strong accuracy with transfer learning.
tools.usage:
net = deeplabv3plus(imageSize, numClasses, network)
net = deeplabv3plus(___, Name=Value)
tools.example:
net = deeplabv3plus([720 960 3], 11, "resnet18");
net = trainnet(trainDS, net, "crossentropy", trainingOptions("sgdm", MaxEpochs=30));
tools.notes: Backbone networks require their pretrained model support packages.

tools.name: evaluateSemanticSegmentation
tools.description: Evaluates semantic segmentation results against ground truth, computing global and class accuracy, IoU, weighted IoU, BF score and confusion matrices for a whole dataset.
tools.usage:
metrics = evaluateSemanticSegmentation(dsResults, dsTruth)
metrics = evaluateSemanticSegmentation(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: dsResults / dsTruth
parameters.description: Pixel label datastores of predictions and ground truth.

tools.notes: dice, jaccard and bfscore compute single-image metrics.

tools.name: detectTextCRAFT
tools.description: Detects text regions in natural images using the pretrained CRAFT (Character Region Awareness for Text) deep learning model, returning bounding boxes to feed into ocr.
tools.usage:
bboxes = detectTextCRAFT(I)
bboxes = detectTextCRAFT(I, roi)
[bboxes, score] = detectTextCRAFT(___, Name=Value)
tools.notes: Requires the Computer Vision Toolbox Model for Text Detection support package.

tools.name: trainOCR
tools.description: Trains or fine-tunes an OCR model (for ocr) on labeled word/line images, e.g. for custom fonts, industrial markings or special character sets, starting from a base model.
tools.usage: [ocrModel, info] = trainOCR(trainingData, outputModelName, baseModel, trainingOptions)

parameters.name: trainingData
parameters.description: Combined datastore of images, bounding boxes and text (from ocrTrainingData).

tools.notes: Introduced R2023a. Evaluate with evaluateOCR (character and word error rates); quantizeOCR reduces model size.

tools.name: evaluateOCR
tools.description: Evaluates OCR results against ground-truth text, returning ocrMetrics with character error rate and word error rate for the dataset and per image.
tools.usage:
metrics = evaluateOCR(ocrResults, groundTruth)
metrics = evaluateOCR(___, Verbose=tf)

parameters.name: ocrResults
parameters.description: ocrText results for the test images.

parameters.name: groundTruth
parameters.description: Datastore or cell array of ground-truth text.

tools.notes: Use it to compare base and fine-tuned models.

tools.name: readArucoMarker
tools.description: Detects and decodes ArUco fiducial markers in an image, returning IDs and corner locations, and optionally their 3-D poses given camera intrinsics and marker size.
tools.usage:
[ids, locs, detectedFamily] = readArucoMarker(I)
[ids, locs, detectedFamily] = readArucoMarker(I, markerFamily)
[ids, locs, detectedFamily, poses] = readArucoMarker(I, markerFamily, intrinsics, markerSize)

parameters.name: intrinsics / markerSize
parameters.description: cameraIntrinsics and marker side length for pose estimation.

tools.notes: generateArucoMarker creates marker images for printing. readAprilTag handles AprilTag families similarly.

tools.name: readAprilTag
tools.description: Detects and decodes AprilTag fiducial markers and, given camera intrinsics and tag size, estimates each tag's 6-DOF pose; widely used for robot localization and camera calibration checks.
tools.usage:
[id, loc, detectedFamily] = readAprilTag(I)
[id, loc, detectedFamily] = readAprilTag(I, tagFamily)
[id, loc, pose, detectedFamily] = readAprilTag(I, tagFamily, intrinsics, tagSize)

parameters.name: intrinsics / tagSize
parameters.description: cameraIntrinsics and tag size (world units) for pose estimation.

tools.notes: Poses are rigidtform3d objects in camera coordinates.

tools.name: groundTruth
tools.description: Stores ground-truth labels (ROI rectangles, polygons, cuboids, pixel labels, scene labels) for image collections, videos or custom data sources, as exported from the labeler apps and used to create training data.
tools.usage: gTruth = groundTruth(dataSource, labelDefs, labelData)

parameters.name: dataSource
parameters.description: groundTruthDataSource for images, video or image sequences.

parameters.name: labelData
parameters.description: Table or timetable of label values.

tools.notes: groundTruthLidar and groundTruthMultisignal hold lidar and multi-sensor labels (Automated Driving / Point Cloud toolboxes).
